curriculumProof.bbbRelation: BBB-edited: all four parts, but condensed and paraphrased. The stem sentences, the 'ללא שינוי' conditions and the owner's direct quote are dropped, and a כן/לא choice is added.
presentationChanges: 'אפשרות א ':להגדיל' / 'אפשרות ב ':להגדיל' → 'אפשרות א': להגדיל' / 'אפשרות ב': להגדיל' (the apostrophe and colon were displaced by RTL typesetting, p18)
Whitespace only: 'חרוט .' → 'חרוט.', 'הסבירו .' → 'הסבירו.', 'העליונה  עד' and 'סמ"ק  גלידה' double spaces → single space

Typography only: the abbreviations ס"מ / סמ"ק are set with gershayim (ס״מ, סמ״ק) as everywhere else in harut. Quotation marks stay ASCII ". Non-breaking spaces were added between 6/10 and ס״מ in the data list.
